en: A vintage black‑and‑white winter scene showing a large group of men and boys standing on snow with skis and sleds. They wear dark uniforms and caps, and there are large ice‑sailing boats with tall masts and sails in the background on a frozen surface, likely a lake. Printed text below the image reads "Sportverein Kaiserwald." The lower margin contains handwritten text in old German script.
